turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
You called this meeting about Owen's zero. Who decided it, and on what basis?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
I didn't say open. Who decided the zero?
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
It says nothing about the zero. You've dodged my question twice now, Hale, so answer it.
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
No deal. Who entered the zero, and did anyone talk to Owen first?
